
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55060948">
最近单位换了UOS系统的国产电脑，因工作需要很多数据需要自动点击确认，弄了一个代码。看大家有需要的吗。<br>
360浏览器&nbsp; &nbsp;F12 → Console → 粘贴 → 回车就能用！<br>
<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">(function() {
    let records = [];
    let recording = false;
    let running = false;
    let speed = 1.0;

    // 开始记录
    window.startRecord = function() {
        records = [];
        recording = true;
        console.log("&amp;#9989; 开始记录");
        document.addEventListener("click", recordClick, true);
    };

    // 记录点击位置
    function recordClick(e) {
        if (!recording) return;
        records.push({
            x: e.clientX,
            y: e.clientY
        });
    }

    // 停止记录
    window.stopRecord = function() {
        recording = false;
        document.removeEventListener("click", recordClick, true);
        console.log("&amp;#9989; 记录完成：" + records.length + " 次点击");
    };

    // 循环点击（加固版）
    window.loopRun = async function() {
        if (records.length === 0) return;
        if (running) return;
        running = true;

        while (running) {
            for (let i = 0; i &lt; records.length; i++) {
                if (!running) break;
                try {
                    const el = document.elementFromPoint(records[i].x, records[i].y);
                    if (el) el.click();
                } catch (e) {}

                // 延迟时间（可加速/减速）
                await new Promise(r =&gt; setTimeout(r, 400 / speed));
            }
        }
    };

    // 停止所有
    window.stopAll = function() {
        running = false;
        recording = false;
        console.log("&amp;#9209; 已停止");
    };

    // 速度调节
    window.setSpeed = function(v) {
        speed = parseFloat(v);
        document.getElementById("speedText").innerText = speed.toFixed(1) + "x";
    };

    // 悬浮面板
    const panel = document.createElement("div");
    panel.style = "position:fixed;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:999999;background:#1a1a1a;color:#fff;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;width:170px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    panel.innerHTML = `
        &lt;button style="width:100%;padding:6px;margin:2px 0;background:#0066cc;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"&gt;开始记录&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button style="width:100%;padding:6px;margin:2px 0;background:#cc4400;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"&gt;停止记录&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button style="width:100%;padding:6px;margin:2px 0;background:#009933;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"&gt;循环播放&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button style="width:100%;padding:6px;margin:2px 0;background:#666;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px"&gt;&amp;#9209; 停止&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;div style="margin-top:8px"&gt;
            速度：&lt;span id="speedText"&gt;1.0x&lt;/span&gt;
            &lt;input type="range" min="0.1" max="5" step="0.1" value="1.0" style="width:100%;margin-top:4px"&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(panel);
    console.log("&amp;#9989; UOS 加固完美版 加载成功");
})();</pre></div><br>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
